name: SEC Electric Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Wuxi, China, SEC Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and supplier of a broad range of electric motors and related electrical apparatus. The company's comprehensive motor portfolio features diverse AC models, including squirrel cage asynchronous, wound rotor induction, compact asynchronous, flameproof, safety, petroleum drilling, and marine propulsion motors. It also produces medium and large DC motors, alongside various synchronous motors, synchronous variable frequency motors, and specialized motors for mine hoists and milling applications. Beyond motors, SEC Electric Machinery also provides a selection of generators, such as wind, turbo, short-circuit, and diesel engine types, as well as essential electrical components like transformers and frequency inverters. These products are utilized across numerous industrial sectors, including metallurgy, power generation, cement, petrochemicals, mining, papermaking, oil drilling, wind energy, water management, and shipbuilding. While operating primarily within China, the company also extends its reach globally, exporting its products to international markets such as the United States, Germany, Switzerland, France, Italy, Russia, South Korea, South Africa, Brazil, India, and Egypt.
